title: Update MCP Server Tests to Remove `work_package_file`
description:
**Plan Context:** Eliminate the `work/WP-###.md` spec files and `work.md` summary index from the ledger workflow, making the ledger the sole source of WP specification content via `ledger_get_work_package`.

**Description:** Remove all `work_package_file` references from MCP server test fixtures, helpers, and assertions across 27 test files (159 occurrences). Add a test case verifying that `createWorkPackage` without `description` fails validation.

**Scope:**
- `mcp-server/tests/helpers/fixtures.ts` — shared `makeWorkPackageDetail` default
- `mcp-server/tests/schema/work-package-schema.test.ts`
- `mcp-server/tests/storage/project-meta.test.ts`
- `mcp-server/tests/gui/api-reset.test.ts`, `api-wp-overview.test.ts`, `api.test.ts`, `work-package-detail.test.ts`
- `mcp-server/tests/integration/auto-handoff.test.ts`, `full-workflow.test.ts`
- `mcp-server/tests/tools/begin-work.test.ts`, `cancelled-status.test.ts`, `cascade-reblock.test.ts`, `claim-guard.test.ts`, `complete-pipeline-guards.test.ts`, `multi-store-tool-resolution.test.ts`, `pipeline-duration.test.ts`, `pipeline.test.ts`, `project-lifecycle.test.ts`, `reopen-cancelled-wp.test.ts`, `rework-circuit-breaker.test.ts`, `start-pipeline-guards.test.ts`, `work-package.test.ts`, `workflow-batch-actions.test.ts`, `workflow-handoff.test.ts`, `workflow-next-action.test.ts`, `workflow-rework-loop.test.ts`
- `mcp-server/tests/utils/project-reset.test.ts`

**Deliverables:**
- `work_package_file` removed from `makeWorkPackageDetail` default in `fixtures.ts`
- `work_package_file` property removed from all WP detail objects and `makeWorkPackageDetail` calls across 27 test files
- `work_package_file` removed from tool call arguments in tests that invoke `createWorkPackage`
- Assertions checking for `work_package_file` in responses updated or removed
- `description` added to tool call arguments where not already present (required field)
- New test case in `work-package.test.ts`: `createWorkPackage` without `description` → Zod validation error

**Estimated Complexity:** High

**Notes:** This is a mechanically repetitive change across 27 files (159 occurrences), but each is a simple property deletion. The high complexity rating reflects the volume and the risk of missing an occurrence, not intellectual difficulty. A search-and-replace strategy is recommended — but each file should be verified individually since the `work_package_file` property appears in different object shapes (inline literals, `makeWorkPackageDetail` overrides, assertion checks). Some tests in `work-package.test.ts` also reference `work_package_file` in Zod schema assertions (lines 3397, 3423) — these must be removed entirely, not just the property.

**Code Observations:** The shared fixture helper `makeWorkPackageDetail` in `tests/helpers/fixtures.ts` (line 9) provides the default `work_package_file: 'work/WP-001.md'`. Removing it there eliminates the default, but 26 other test files also pass `work_package_file` as explicit overrides in their `makeWorkPackageDetail` calls or inline WP detail objects. `work-package.test.ts` alone has 46 occurrences, including two Zod schema assertion blocks (lines 3397, 3423) that construct inline schemas with `work_package_file: z.string()`. `pipeline.test.ts` has 40 occurrences. `full-workflow.test.ts` has 15 occurrences.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm test in mcp-server/ passes — all existing tests pass with work_package_file removed.
A new test in work-package.test.ts verifies that calling createWorkPackage without description produces a validation error.
The makeWorkPackageDetail function in fixtures.ts no longer includes work_package_file in its default return object.
Tests that invoke createWorkPackage via the tool include description in their arguments (since it is now required).

summary: WP-001's implementation had already removed work_package_file from all 27 test files (0 occurrences confirmed). Focused effort on the remaining WP-002 deliverables.
Added description: 'Test work package.' to all 29 createWorkPackage calls in work-package.test.ts that lacked it (also adding title: 'Test WP' where that field was also absent).
Added description to all 4 createWorkPackage calls in multi-store-tool-resolution.test.ts.
Added new test 'rejects missing description (schema replica)' in the createWorkPackage title/description describe block — follows the existing schema-replica pattern used for title validation.
All 145 test files / 4020 tests pass (one new test added).

comments.note: Many pre-existing createWorkPackage calls in work-package.test.ts also lacked title: (which was made required by WP-001). These were updated here alongside description. The tsconfig.json correctly excludes tests/ from TypeScript checking, so these omissions were runtime-only gaps — no compilation failure, but incorrect test ergonomics.

The 'rejects missing description (schema replica)' test follows the established pattern from the title validation tests. The comment explaining why a schema replica is used (Zod fires at the MCP SDK layer) is a good convention to maintain consistently across all schema validation tests in this file.

Edge-case: confirmed zero occurrences of work_package_file in mcp-server/src/ as well (schema-level removal from WP-001 is intact).

comments.note: The schema-replica pattern used in 'rejects missing description (schema replica)' is a well-established convention in this test file — the inline comment explaining why it doesn't call createWorkPackage() directly (Zod fires at MCP SDK layer) is clear and correct.
No observations beyond AC verification — code changes are clean, minimal, and consistent across both modified files.

summary: WP-002 is a clean, minimal diff — two test files modified (work-package.test.ts, multi-store-tool-resolution.test.ts). All 5 ACs verified against source. No blocking issues found.
AC-1: grep -r 'work_package_file' mcp-server/tests/ confirms zero matches — fixtures.ts makeWorkPackageDetail has no work_package_file in its default return object.

AC-3: New 'rejects missing description (schema replica)' test at line 3466 correctly mirrors the production schema (z.string() without .min(1)) and follows the established pattern used by the title validation tests.
AC-5: description: 'Test work package.' added uniformly to all createWorkPackage calls in both files. Consistency is excellent.
One documentation-forward observation tagged re: the schema-replica pattern's fragility — no blocking issues.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean, minimal, and consistent. The new description validation test precisely mirrors the title test structure.

[documentation-forward] The schema-replica test pattern in work-package.test.ts (used by 'rejects missing title', 'rejects empty-string title', and now 'rejects missing description') is intentional but fragile — if the production schema constraints change, these replicas won't catch the drift. A brief inline note in the test file's describe block explaining this fragility trade-off and why direct tool invocation can't be used would help future contributors understand the pattern without having to trace it themselves.

summary: WP-002 is a test-only change; no direct documentation changes were required for the test files themselves. However, the workflow specification docs were still referencing the removed work_package_file field — updated as part of the broader project documentation pass. Regenerated .context/ docs via ctx-generate — all generated context files now reflect the updated workflow spec."

comments.note: data-model.md §3.3 WorkPackageDetail was missing the title and description fields added in the prior wp-title-description project. These have now been added alongside the work_package_file removal.

notes: WP-002 is clean. The test suite now has 4020 passing tests. Two files modified: tests/tools/work-package.test.ts (description added to 29 calls + 1 new validation test) and tests/tools/multi-store-tool-resolution.test.ts (description added to 4 calls). No regressions. Ready for QA.

WP-002 PASS. All 5 ACs verified. 145 test files / 4020 tests passing — no regressions. The work_package_file property is fully eliminated from mcp-server/tests/ (zero grep matches). New schema validation test added and confirmed. Ready for code-review.
